payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the model uses visual contexts to improve its predictions and recognizes entities by associating image parts with words, particularly through the modality attention module.

claims.text: The model incorporates visual contexts to enhance named entity recognition, successfully associating image parts with relevant words.
The modality attention module helps the model focus on effective visual contexts, improving predictions of named entities based on image features.
Visual contexts provide auxiliary information that aids in disambiguating polysemous tokens in captions, indicating the model's ability to learn associations between images and words.
